news.title: Uber caps employee AI spending after blowing through budget in 4 months
news.description: Uber's cutback has occurred after the company had reportedly encouraged staff to use AI as much as possible.

news.title: New Microsoft tool lets devs spin up AI behavior tests using text descriptions
news.description: Microsoft on Tuesday took the wraps off Adaptive Spec-driven Scoring for Evaluation and Regression Testing, an open source framework for spinning up AI evaluations.

news.title: Martin Scorsese becomes the latest — and most unlikely — Hollywood voice for AI
news.description: The caveat is that one of the world's most famous living directors is using the tech solely for storyboarding.

news.title: Publishers in UK can opt out of Google AI search results
news.description: The Competition and Markets Authority says it would put publishers "in a stronger position to negotiate content deals with Google".

news.title: Do you find yourself aimlessly scrolling? You're not alone
news.description: A Virgin Media O2 report suggests an average of 36% of time spent on phones is without a clear purpose.

news.title: Microsoft testing wearable AI gadget aimed at office workers
news.description: The company said its own workers are testing a "wearable access badge" and a desktop device.

news.title: Instagram AI chatbot tricked by hackers to give access to others' accounts
news.description: Some reports have linked the incident to recent cases of high-profile Instagram accounts being hijacked.

news.title: Redditors Are Using AI to Beat Obscene World Cup Ticket Prices
news.description: Soccer fans on r/WorldCup2026Tickets are using Claude to build DIY ticketing software, exchanging on back channels, and leaving scalpers scrambling.
